newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank cuts Linde 96,97 EPS forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank cuts Linde 96,97 EPS forecasts.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Hypotheken und Wechsel-Bank AG said on Tuesday it was cutting its earnings per share forecasts for engineering group Linde AG as its first-half earnings were lower than expected.
Analyst Juergen Warfsmann told Reuters he would reduce his 1996 EPS forecast for the group to 42.20 marks from 45 marks, and would cut the 1997 forecast to 45 marks from 48 marks.
The bank is, however, keeping the share on "hold".
Linde reported first half pre-tax profit of 262.1 million marks, below Warfsmann's forecast for profit of over 300 million marks.

"I would not say this is very much less than expected as it is often hard to predict first-half earnings but it is certainly under my forecast. I had expected that the first half would show more dynamic growth," Warfsmann said.
"I think the pressure on the share will be more of a short-term phenomenon," he added.
Linde's shares were trading down six marks at 925 marks on the news in pre-bourse trade, but were off a session low of 915 marks.
